hints.content:
For the $x$ pattern, we add $7$ more to each row.

For the $y$ pattern, we subtract $2$ from each row.

Pattern $x$: Add $\goldE{7}$

$\begin{align}\text{Starting term}&: \blueE{4}\\\\
\text{Term 2}&:\blueE{4} + \goldE{7}=\maroonE{11}\\\\
\text{Term 3}&:\maroonE{11} + \goldE{7}=\purpleD{18}\end{align}$

Pattern $y$: Subtract $\tealE{2}$

$\begin{align}\text{Starting term}&: \blueE{15}\\\\
\text{Term 2}&:\blueE{15} - \tealE{2}=\maroonE{13}\\\\
\text{Term 3}&:\maroonE{13} - \tealE{2}=\purpleD{11}\end{align}$

Our table of values should look like this:

$x$ | $y$ 
- | - | -
$4$ | $15$ 
$11$ | $13$ 
$18$ | $11$
